# Redistributable mathematical image fixtures

These fixtures contain generated color swatches only. They contain no user photos
or private camera metadata. The generated data and generator are dedicated to the
public domain (CC0).

`generated-linear-mask.dng` is generated by `scripts/generate_dng_fixture.py` using
NumPy and tifffile. A single explicit ForwardMatrix, non-unit AsShotNeutral and
six camera-space patches have an independent float64 reference: fixed
D50-to-linear-sRGB matrix × ForwardMatrix × diagonal(1/neutral) × camera RGB.
The JSON oracle is computed without Adobe SDK or LibRaw. One patch produces
negative green and red above one. The separate transparency SubIFD contains
zero, partial and opaque samples. TIFF PhotometricInterpretation is patched to
LinearRaw after writing RGB so tifffile does not invent ExtraSamples.

`generated-swatches.png` is a 3×2 RGBA PNG: red/green/blue and gray/white/black,
including half and zero alpha. `generated-swatches-10bit.avif` was encoded using
libavif 1.4.2's avifenc, AOM 3.15.0:

```
avifenc -j 1 --lossless --depth 10 --yuv 444 --cicp 1/13/0 \
  generated-swatches.png generated-swatches-10bit.avif
```

Raster TIFF/PNG/WebP/BMP, 16-bit precision, malformed images, PSD composites and
all eight EXIF orientation cases are generated in temporary directories by tests.
Official DNG SDK sample files are available through the verified SDK download;
they are governed by the SDK's license and are not copied into this fixture set.
